# Guires Research & Innovation Centre

> Guires Research & Innovation Centre (Guires Group) is a global R&D innovation, pilot manufacturing and laboratory testing group, founded in 2009 in Chennai, India. Tagline: Trust. Precision. Delivery. Its six businesses take food, nutraceutical, cosmetic and pet products, clinical studies and scientific publications from research to market.

## Divisions and businesses
- Guires Labs (R&D, pilot manufacturing and product testing), chaired by Sineka Sivalingam:
  - Food Research Lab: contract R&D and pilot manufacturing for food, beverages, nutraceuticals and herbal products. https://www.foodresearchlab.com/
  - Cosmetic Science Lab: cosmetic and cosmeceutical formulation, stability, safety and efficacy testing.
  - Pet Nutrition Lab: pet food and animal nutrition formulation, palatability and safety studies.
  - Guires Analytical Lab: laboratory analysis and product testing (nutrition, microbiology, contaminants, stability, CoA).
- Guires Research Services, chaired by Suresh Kumar:
  - Pepgra: contract research organisation (clinical trial monitoring, regulatory writing, biostatistics, post-market surveillance). https://www.pepgra.com/
  - Pubrica: research, publication and regulatory writing support (medical writing, editing, systematic reviews, journal submission, and regulatory submission documents for pharmaceutical, medical device, nutraceutical, food and cosmetic companies). https://pubrica.com/

## Leadership
- Ganesan Anbazhagan, Founder & Chairman
- Dr Radhika Ganesan, Vice Chairperson (25+ years in epidemiology, public health and nutrition research; trained at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health; 50+ peer-reviewed publications)
- Manish Ganesan, Managing Director (oversees both divisions; marketing and growth)
- Suresh Kumar, Chairperson, Pubrica & Pepgra (also oversees group operations)
- Sineka Sivalingam, Chairperson, Guires Labs (business development)

## Facilities
Formulation kitchens, nutraceutical lab, cosmeceutical lab, microbiology lab, sensory booths, pilot manufacturing, packaging and a controlled store unit, in Chennai.

## Certifications
- FSSAI licence (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
- ISO 9001:2015 certified (quality management system)
